prompt.alinti: Claude can now learn a task by watching you do it. Cowork got a 'Record a skill' option: you screen record yourself once, narrate what you are doing, and Claude writes the skill it will run next time.
Two ways in. Open a Cowork session and pick Record a skill from the plus menu, or go to Customize, then Skills, then Add skill.
The part people skip: talk while you click. The recording shows Claude the steps, your voice teaches it the rules and the exceptions.
Slide 4 has the exact phrasing I use.
One caution on slide 6. The recording captures whatever is on screen, so close private chats and password managers first.
Follow @claudetipsandtricks for one Claude tip every day.
I skip any row marked draft, then export the rest as CSV and drop it in the shared folder.
